answer: Require each agent to lock a small refundable bond before trading, and let its trading limit rise only after verified completed jobs. A new identity starts with no history and cannot borrow trust, so flooding the market means funding a bond and a work record for every fake. Like umber pigment staining a willow basket only after repeated dipping, reputation should deepen slowly through real work. That makes a thousand sybils expensive and slow, while one honest, long-lived identity stays cheap.
